purpose: Correct cash-flow contract representation, regenerate single-condition counterfactual MC, reevaluate frozen Stage-1, and compare controlled training improvements
scope: STEP/FROM_ISU LIZARD with explicit regular or monthly coupons; inception-only constant GBM; all payment dates explicit
market_assumptions: Source flat ATM IV / HV fallback, 180-return correlation, piecewise-linear KRW zero curve, q=0
split: Reuse fixed 2048/256/256 family/template split. All variants stay with their family. Market donors are not independently held out.
coupon_intervention: Change annual coupon only; fixed regular, survival and monthly accrual factors. Lizard redemption premium stays fixed. Monthly coupon barrier has a separate named intervention from KI barrier.

learning.selection_metric: validation price RMSE + 4 * increment RMSE, in KRW, common to all arms
learning.normalization: Training rows only. 461 contract features include 60 monthly observation/payment/barrier/payment/accrual/mask slots and same-day entitlement. Coupon-affine arm masks every coupon-dependent payment feature.
learning.affine_arm: A DeepONet with coupon-independent intercept and nonnegative coupon slope; justified only for the explicitly affine coupon intervention; separate arm from data/loss ablations

frozen_model: Nine new Stage-1 checkpoints are trained on this experiment's reference payoff labels with source ATM IV/HV fallback and piecewise-linear zero rates. Three prespecified learning arms each use three training seeds. They are frozen by validation before terms and schedule test evaluation. The earlier V3 affine-coupon ensemble is also evaluated unchanged as a separate prior-frozen comparator. No Stage 2 or PI loss is used.
evaluation: increment MAE/RMSE/bias by axis and bump
tolerance_note: 1/5/10 KRW thresholds summarize absolute increment prediction errors.
legacy_preservation: Original engine, historical labels, checkpoints and earlier experiment results preserved; new module and versioned experiment used throughout
real_data_note: Six previously excluded monthly contracts individually reconciled to public DART terms. Source evaluation dates retained; issuer-specific 2/3 business-day settlement under pinned KR public+bank calendar. Remaining raw monthly schedules are used to DEFINE synthetic contracts, not claimed fully verified original product prices.
training_extension_policy: No automatic extension or test-driven tuning. All three arms and three seeds use the same fixed maximum and validation selection.
monthly_rounding_note: Unit-notional theoretical present values before investor-specific aggregate-payment KRW truncation/taxes; rounding is not added per 10,000-won unit.
input_curve: Actual bootstrap zero rates at original ten branch nodes, never NS nodes for a bootstrap label
comparison: Two independent sets of nine Stage-1 checkpoints trained against paired labels for the two payoff implementations
